TikTok integration

Arcway Operations

A secure workspace that lets authorized business account owners review and approve original video content before it is published to their TikTok profile.

Account owner controlledEvery TikTok account grants access through TikTok Login Kit.
Approval requiredNo video is posted before an authorized operator confirms the exact preview.
Scoped accessTokens, media and tasks are isolated by account and workspace.
RevocableAccount owners can revoke access through TikTok at any time.

How it works

  1. An account owner opens the authorization link and signs in directly with TikTok.
  2. TikTok displays the requested permissions for profile identification, draft upload and direct posting.
  3. The owner approves access. Arcway Operations stores the resulting token encrypted on the operator's private server.
  4. An authorized operator uploads original content, reviews the caption, target account and privacy setting, and confirms a unique approval code.
  5. The service queries the account's current posting options and submits the approved content through TikTok's Content Posting API.

Requested permissions

user.info.basic identifies the selected TikTok account. video.upload sends creator-editable drafts. video.publish publishes an explicitly approved video to the authorized profile.

Arcway Operations does not ask account owners to share their TikTok password. Authentication and consent happen on TikTok's own authorization page.

Support

Questions about account access, removal or content publishing can be sent to developer@bgmyangon.com.
